faq: Which precast products can this solution support?

The proposed configurations cover solid walls, insulated sandwich wall panels, lattice girder slabs and selected special precast elements. We confirm compatibility from your product drawings, dimensions and reinforcement details.
Should we choose a carousel line or a long-line solution?
The choice depends on product repetition, output targets, available space and the work required at each station. We review the product mix and production flow before recommending a configuration.
What determines the cost of a precast plant?

Cost depends on the product range, capacity, automation, curing, handling, reinforcement preparation and site interfaces. Your proposal separates equipment and services from civil works, local utilities and other project costs.
What information is needed for a plant proposal?

Start with your project country, intended products and output target. Product drawings, shift plans, building dimensions, crane capacity and available utilities help us prepare a more useful review. If some information is unavailable, we can clarify it with you.
Can REALJET help upgrade an existing plant?
Yes. We can review your existing layout, equipment interfaces and production bottlenecks to assess suitable upgrades. The scope is defined after checking the current system and the changes required.
What installation and training are included?
Installation, commissioning, training and support are defined in the agreed package. We identify site preparation, customer responsibilities and local contractor work before implementation.

We assess capacity using the product mix, pallet or bed arrangement, station cycle times, shifts, curing and handling limits. Preliminary figures are planning assumptions until project conditions and acceptance criteria are agreed.

equipment: One-touch concrete loading and return, intelligent weighing, concrete setting alarm and fault self-diagnosis. Remote and control-panel operation with automatic lubrication.
Clamping vibration with multi-stage cushioning. Adjustable vibration frequency and installation height, with high excitation force.

Servo-driven rack-and-pinion positioning, automatic storage-bay recognition and coordinated control. Station safety interlocks, automatic or semi-automatic operation, and an overhead suspended structure.

Integrated multi-level rack structure with independent temperature and humidity control for each chamber row. Hot-air circulation maintains uniform temperatures between levels; steam curing is supported.
One-touch automatic tilting, automatic pallet locking and synchronized hydraulic-cylinder control. Operated by remote control or control panel.
Synchronized lifting by dual drives, servo-controlled travel and separate sensing for deceleration and stopping.
Easy-clean hopper, high travel speed and coordinated control. Precise positioning, remote operation and automatic tracking and stopping.
Automatic pin insertion and withdrawal, two stressing modes and one-touch return to the starting position. Sensors monitor reinforcement stressing force and cylinder stroke in real time.
Automatic film laying with quick-release film rollers and fast reinforcement clamping. Anti-disengagement comb design, polyurethane-coated wheels and remote-control operation.

Surface roughening and collection of stop-end and side shutters in one operation. Assisted lifting, one-touch raising and lowering of the roughening unit, a dedicated storage platform, and remote or control-panel operation.
Hydraulic position locking and coordinated transfer between production beds. Conductor-rail power supply with remote-control and control-panel operation.
Motor-driven, one-touch automatic extension and retraction. Automated operation reduces manual intervention during steam curing.
